seen.where: Gallica ital. 1584 (ark btv1b100373864) via openapi.bnf.fr IIIF, canvases 120, 190-191, 287-288, 293 viewed at 1000-1300 px; canvas offset to stamped folio is -5/-6 (canvas 120 = f. 125, 190/191 = f. 198, 288 = ff. 293/295, 293 = f. 299)
seen.extent: f. 125 (19 Apr 1447, Tivoli, Pietro di Monferrato): about 9 lines of cipher inside a clear Latin/Italian letter, no gloss. f. 198 (8 July 1447, Ferrara, Raphael Pugnelus): clear opening, then almost the whole page in cipher with small interlinear/marginal glosses over some groups (names such as 'Pietro da Pistoia', 'cardinale' in a small hand), so a partial contemporary decipherment of name groups; a clear sheet of the same date sits on the facing leaf (f. 197) but I could not tell whether it is a copy of f. 198. f. 295 (6 Sept 1447, Ferrara): about 12 lines of pure cipher signs, no gloss; the 5 Sept letter f. 294 beside it has a clear leaf f. 293 of the same date in a late italic hand (probably a decipherment copy of f. 294, not of f. 295). f. 299 parchment: one full page of cipher signs, no gloss seen. f. 306 not individually inspected (sheet at canvas ~300 is a parchment page of cipher signs).
seen.cipher: Symbol ciphers (several sign repertoires: round/cursive Greek-like forms on f. 125, angular +/U/3/9 forms on f. 198) mixed into clear Italian; f. 198 carries partial interlinear name glosses, f. 125/295/299 none seen. The late-hand clear copies filed in this volume for Barbavara/Pusterla (see targets/barbavara1447/NOTES.md) make a copy for individual leaves possible; ff. 125, 295, 299 show none beside them.
